2900.translation: Researchers follow 480 primary-school students for two years to study reading amount and vocabulary. Group wey read more get higher vocabulary scores. But researchers no conclude say reading cause better vocabulary. Children wey already sabi more words fit enjoy reading more from start; dem no fit rule that out. To confirm cause, dem say experiment wey deliberately change reading environment must follow.

2901.translation: Our committee agree with aim of this amendment. But bringing implementation date earlier need caution. Small workplaces fit no get enough staff and money to meet new standards quickly. Tightening rules without preparation fit make more businesses close, against the intention. So committee recommend different grace periods by workplace size, with technical support meanwhile.

2902.translation: For early industrial period, workers wey rush go cities live for poor housing. Thinkers respond in two main ways. One side blame weak individual morals and stress moral improvement. Other side blame structural inequality and demand better institutions. Today poverty-policy debate still resemble that divide, showing how deep problem roots be.

2903.translation: Citizen group demand make local council publish more meeting minutes. Council hide some content because e fit invade speakers privacy. But public statements should face public checking. Hiding policy discussion wey no concern privacy no convincing. Make dem clearly identify which information need protection, and publish the rest as normal rule. Avoiding disclosure na council itself reducing trust.

2904.translation: This study show meaningful link between exercise habits and depressive symptoms.

2905.translation: If this trend continue, regional decline fit become faster.

2906.translation: Report say damage grow because response no quick.

2907.translation: Even though policy aim good, questions remain about fair enforcement.

2908.translation: People criticise guideline say even after revision, dem still no dey follow am enough for actual work.

2909.translation: Experts predict say this measure fit bring only short-term effect.

2910.translation: View say this matter na structural problem instead of only individual wrongdoing dey gain support.

2911.translation: Local government announce say retail sales rise 12 percent after dem issue more local vouchers. But neighbouring area sales rise about the same during that period. More than half of voucher spending go big stores wey already get plenty regular customers. Institute say this data alone no show whether vouchers create new spending or just change payment method for purchases already planned. Local government plan continue issuing same amount next quarter.

2912.translation: City council pass rule against delivery motorcycles using pavement, but delay enforcement one year. Members say need for enforcement no be the disagreement. Still, fines without considering delivery workers income structure fit only push violations to hidden places. City say e go add temporary stopping areas during grace period. Most members present vote yes.

2913.translation: Three other laboratories try reproduce new material superconductivity wey one research team announce. Two fail. Original team say sample purity difference fit cause am. Even the successful laboratory say test temperature range differ, so direct comparison hard. Scientists no quickly reject result as error or accept am as achievement. Before practical use, dem need confirm whether same property appear at room temperature.

2914.translation: Traders say traditional market becoming tourist attraction bring more visitors but fewer regular customers. Market association judge say foreign visitors raise sales. Yet some traders describe am as market day wey still dey, but the market itself don disappear. One trader admit say daily sales really rise, but no finish the thought. Association plan expand visitor information centres next year.

2915.translation: Government announce say people aged 60 or above pass 20 percent of all employed people for first time this year. But detailed figures show most increase come from short-term public jobs below 15 hours weekly. Average monthly income actually fall. Criticism return say employment rate no show job quality. Official say detailed analysis go come next month. Experts say same figure fit lead to different policy diagnosis depending on interpretation.

2916.translation: For translation conference, presenter say the more culture a source word carry, the more choosing nearest equivalent alone fit flatten meaning. Presenter accept say footnotes fit break reader immersion. Still, easy-to-read translation no necessarily faithful translation. Conference decide make this matter formal debate topic for next year meeting.

2917.translation: Public institution say e go release citizens movement records to researchers after removing names and addresses. Institution claim say removing identifying details mean privacy no at risk. But law scholar point to foreign research where route and time alone fit identify people. Institution no give separate answer to this concern. Release date never final.
